The Rotaract Club of Angono is a community-based Rotaract club chartered on 3 January 2019 under Rotary International District 3800, sponsored by the Rotary Club of Angono. We bring together young leaders in Angono, Rizal — the Art Capital of the Philippines — for community service, professional development, and fellowship.

Basic Education and Literacy

Edu-Aksyon Year 6

In line with its commitment to bringing educational resources and encouraging learning one step at a time, the Rotaract Club of Tiaong Transforming New Gen proudly continues its legacy project, Edu-Aksyon Year 6. The project was designed to create a fun, safe, and engaging learning environment for the kindergarten pupils of San Isidro Elementary School through interactive educational activities that nurture learning, health, and literacy. Hosted by Rtrs. Axel, Kim and SD Alexa, the program formally opened with preliminaries. To energize the kindergarten pupils, members of the Interact Club of AITE facilitated a lively energizer, with exciting prizes awarded to the best 5 dancers from the class before the kids proceeded to the four learning stations. The first station featured Project HAKBANG, where kindergarten pupils learned through movement and play by completing interactive challenges through jumping activities. Next, the second station highlighted Keep Our Hands Clean Together Year 4, which promoted proper hand hygiene. The children were taught the correct way of washing their hands and were then guided by the Rotaractors as they practiced proper handwashing themselves. Followed by the third station focused on Project Bright Smiles Year 2, promoting oral health awareness through an interactive toothbrushing demonstration before the children received dental hygiene kits to encourage good oral care habits at home. Lastly, the fourth station showcased Project AddLearn Year 3, strengthening literacy through an interactive storytelling session facilitated by Secretary Hanna of the Rotaract Club of Angono, where the pupils enthusiastically listened and answered questions. After completing all four stations, every kindergarten pupil received literacy worksheets, school supplies, and packed lunches. San Isidro Elementary School also received donations of educational materials, school supplies, and storybooks to further support classroom learning. The program concluded with the Closing Remarks delivered by Principal Ryuz Cruz, followed by a photo opportunity, as well as the presentation of Certificates of Appreciation. Through six years of EDU-AKSYON, the Rotaract Club of Tiaong Transforming New Gen continues to demonstrate that investing in education empowers young minds and creates lasting opportunities. Together with its partners and co-host clubs, the club remains committed to making learning meaningful, inspiring hope, and building a brighter future—one step, one lesson, and one child at a time.

Club MilestoneAug 9, 2026

A New Digital Home for the Club: The Launch of Our Most Functional Website Yet

The Rotaract Club of Angono has officially launched its new club website, creating a digital home where members, prospective members, partners, and the community can discover the club, its people, activities, and impact.More than just an online profile, the new website brings together important aspects of club life in one place—from service projects and events to membership, announcements, stories, and club information.Discover the ClubVisitors can learn about the club's history, meet its leaders and members, explore its activities, and discover the different ways the club serves the community.The website also features the club's awards, recognitions, and partnerships, giving visitors a glimpse into the relationships and achievements that have shaped the Rotaract Club of Angono since its chartering in 2019.See Our Service in ActionAt the heart of the website is a showcase of the club's service projects.Visitors can explore past and ongoing initiatives, learn about the communities and beneficiaries they serve, and view photos and stories from activities.By documenting these experiences, the website helps tell the story behind each project—not only what the club accomplished, but also the people and communities who made each initiative meaningful.Stay ConnectedKeeping up with club activities is now easier through the online calendar, where members and visitors can find meetings, service projects, trainings, social activities, birthdays, and district events.Members also have access to a dedicated space for announcements, activities, personal information, and other club-related needs.For officers and project teams, the platform provides a more organized way to manage projects, membership, documents, finances, and other club activities.The goal is simple: make information easier to find, participation easier, and club operations more organized.Welcoming New MembersThe website also opens the door to young people interested in leadership, friendship, volunteerism, and community service.Prospective members can learn more about the club and submit their membership application online, providing a convenient first step toward joining the Rotaract Club of Angono.Preserving Our StoriesEvery club has stories worth remembering.Through its news and stories section, the website provides a space to share achievements, announcements, project highlights, milestones, and member experiences.As the years go by, these stories will become part of the club's digital history—a record of the people, projects, and moments that continue to shape the organization.A New ChapterThe launch of the website marks another step forward for the Rotaract Club of Angono.Since 3 January 2019, the club has continued to grow through service, leadership, friendship, and community involvement. This new digital home reflects that same spirit of growth and connection.It gives the community a place to discover who we are, gives members a place to stay connected, and gives future members a place to find us.Most importantly, it gives our club a place to share and preserve the impact we create together.One club. One community. One digital home.Welcome to the new website of the Rotaract Club of Angono.

President’s Message

“It is my great honor and privilege to serve as the President of the Rotaract Club of Angono for this Rotary Year.”

As Rotaractors, we are united by a simple yet powerful belief: service can create meaningful change. Every project we undertake, every person we reach, and every partnership we build is an opportunity to make a difference in our community.

This year, we aim to strengthen our club not only through impactful service projects, but also by creating an environment where every member feels valued, empowered, and inspired to contribute. We will continue to embrace collaboration, develop our members' skills, and build lasting friendships along the way.

I believe that leadership is not about standing above others—it is about standing with them. Our achievements this year will not be measured by one person, but by what we accomplish together as a club.

To our members, partners, sponsors, and fellow Rotaractors, thank you for your continued trust and support. May we continue to serve with compassion, lead with purpose, and create lasting impact wherever we go.

Together, let us make this year meaningful, memorable, and truly worth serving for.

Yours in service,

Francesca Adrienne Mae Padilla

High Impact President, Rotary Year 2026-2027
